name: Complexus Medical
old_description: Complexus Medical is a full-service contract manufacturer of medical devices and healthcare products.
about:
Complexus Medical traces its roots to 1968 when F&F Machine Specialties opened in a basement in Mishawaka, Indiana. The company, now led by Michael Behrens, expanded its headquarters in Mishawaka in 2013 and added a second facility in Plymouth, Indiana in 2021.

Today Complexus Medical operates as a full-service contract manufacturer of medical devices and healthcare products. Its services span clean-room assembly, sub-assembly and final assembly, custom kitting and sterile barrier packaging, sterilization coordination (EtO, gamma, and E-beam), supply-chain management, regulatory support, and prototype tooling with pilot production runs. The company runs two U.S. facilities and reports more than 500 products manufactured.

The firm serves medical-device OEMs, with a historic focus on the orthopedic instrument and implant sector. Customers range from early-stage developers needing rapid prototyping to established manufacturers requiring full-scale production, lot traceability, and FDA-compliant documentation.

Complexus emphasizes in-house welding, finishing, and assembly to control quality and lead times on complex, multi-component instruments with tight tolerances. It positions itself as “right-sized”—small enough to know every project detail yet large enough to deliver at scale—backed by over 55 years of combined manufacturing experience.
